guidance.toggle: How to write a prayer request
guidance.title: How to write a prayer request
points: Write the topic in general terms, for example “please pray for my sick friend”.
Do not write names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses or personal identity numbers.
Do not describe anyone so closely that they can be recognised (for example their workplace, street address or a specific situation).
You can pray for yourself or a loved one without a name: “my friend”, “my family”, “my neighbour”.
Requests are checked before publication. Personal data is removed, and only the checked version is shown publicly.
